row.title: TENANT-READINGS-1: spinoff value and spend readings are written from the spinoff ledger
row.body: Every live spinoff read value and spend as unmeasured, so the second loop could never judge them. write_tenants now fills declared_metric/declared_target (latest decision value against portfolio.kill_below_value) and an upper-bound spend_vs_budget (account spend share / app budget_share), and keeps declared_target, which it used to drop. saydo now resolves paths under workers/ because ultrastable/workers is archived and core lives in workers/ here.
